Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Choose Island resources and stock levels, then let Stock Manager select imported Visland routes. Supports route editing and supervised generation, sortable resources, farming priorities with scheduled reviews, flight, underwater and guided cave navigation, an Island route map, mount override, stuck recovery, Lifestream, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm commands.
Changelog: Fixed strict priorities selecting a different resource after respawn filtering. Strict modes now review the active choice every 10 minutes and immediately after setting changes. Added a guided vnavmesh approach through the rank 12 cave entrance instead of navigating directly into terrain.
